messages:
jamie: Heads up: ap-southeast1 spike in fractional GPU evictions ~07:10 local. Scheduler logs show repeated preempts after attach timeouts.

ravi: Yep. `device_attach_duration_ms` p95 jumped to ~16s. Kernel conntrack on several nodes at ~130k of 131072.

claire: Workloads hit are tiny-gang with strict requiredDuringScheduling affinity + hard anti-affinity. Fragmentation means scheduler keeps preempting to free whole nodes.

jamie: Immediate mitigations we can try: 1) canary bump nf_conntrack_max via privileged daemonset to 262k on 10% nodes, 2) mark tiny-gang anti-affinity as soft for 30m, 3) provision +1 warm GPU node in region. Thoughts?

ravi: Start with conntrack canary. Command: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144`. Roll 10% -> 50% if metrics improve (watch conntrack_drops).

claire: I'll prepare a short-lived scheduler override annotation `redwood.io/soft-anti-affinity=true` that makes anti-affinity preferred instead of required. Canary that on low-priority tiny-gang pods.

infra-bot: INC-2026-199 created: "apse1 attach latency -> preempt cascade" assigned to eng-platform.

ops: If canary doesn't reduce preempts in 20m, we'll spin +1 on-demand GPU node in ap-southeast1 for 6h.

jamie: Action items: ravi -> conntrack canary; claire -> scheduler override and rollout doc; ops -> stand by for +1 node. Keep updates in this thread every 10m.
